incident-bot: AUTOMATED ALERT — p99 latency 4.2s (>3s threshold) for inference-api-prod-eu. PagerDuty: P-URGENT PAGER123
alice.m: acked — I'm on it, grabbing traces
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident P-12345 triggered, assigned to alice.m
bob.s: looking at hot metrics now. seeing QPS steady, but p99 spike on tail tokens and KV cache miss rate up
carla: can we try immediate kvcache eviction + warm? also consider shrinking batch size on hot frontends
alice.m: trying kvcache warm first — running:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-kv-cache/proactive_warm -d '{"keys":1000}'
kubectl exec -n inference svc/cache-warm -- /bin/warm --prefix inference-
```
carla: also rolling a canary with fallback-model v1.2-quant (lower mem, less perf) to relieve GPU pressure
ethan: customer impact: support queue has 5 mentions of slow responses; free-tier chat demos timing out. Not major revenue yet but spikes may cascade
bob.s: scaling inference-runtime pool now: `kubectl scale deploy inference-runtime -n prod --replicas=12` — watch autoscaler
incident-bot: Action logged: scale up triggered by alice.m
alice.m: p99 down to 2.1s after warm/warmup, still above 1.5s SLO; continuing mitigation
carla: enabling prefix caching on hot route (/v1/chat) — flipping config in rollout
alice.m: can we temporarily disable large-batch aggregation? config patch applied:
```
PATCH /config/agg
{"max_batch_tokens":512}
```
bob.s: telemetry shows backlog cleared, cpu on sidecars reduced
ethan: I'll post a short customer note if we hit >5min degradation
incident-bot: PagerDuty: escalation to layer2 if not acked in 10m
alice.m: handing off to frank (night oncall) once stable — frank, FYI: p99 at 1.4s, will monitor for 30m then mark resolved if stable
frank: ack — I'll take the next 30m watch, leave notes in incident doc <https://redwood.incidents/1829991111>
alice.m: file for postmortem and RCA — probable root: kvcache eviction churn + batch config hysteresis. follow runbook <https://redwood.runbooks/slo-burn>
carla: noted for rollout queues — we should add auto-warm to kvcache when eviction > X
incident-bot: ALERT cleared: p99 below threshold for 10m — auto-close pending review
alice.m: closing thread, will open formal incident if RCA has customer impact. thanks all :thumbsup:
